roads.name: Going-to-the-Sun Road
words: Properly twisty: 29 curves in 4.5 miles, about 6 a mile.
From 3,166 to 3,198 ft, with 268 ft of up and down along the way.
Water alongside for stretches.
July highs average 80°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 35 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.24 g.
